boundaries: Fixed eight-case sequential before/after observation, not a randomized simultaneous experiment. Each case has one first-request observation per side; 8/8 cannot establish population reliability.
Original strict results are preserved: before 1/8 and after 2/8. Raw first S1 admission checks, clean stop and later shutdown-tail work remain separate fields.
Before and after ran at different wall times. Startup and preparation already varied greatly inside the before batch. No causal latency, filesystem or compiler-effect estimate is derived.

The two retained retired before first requests were MODEL_RESULT_INCOMPLETE at 4096 tokens. They are not relabeled as multiline-JSON parser errors; after's same cases ended with stop at 1532 and 3884 tokens.

The complete raw case-01 system-prompt diff contains three inline-JSON instruction changes plus a perception timestamp and catalog revision. These dynamic differences are retained in hashes, not silently normalized out of the raw evidence.
Both binaries predate the new directory-batch publisher, typed shutdown fix and environment sampler. This observation does not measure any of those later changes.
The observed outcome is first-request/S1 admission of requested children, not completed child computation, native effect, final answer, pause/restart or duplicate-effect recovery.
